# Define the reusable transform for this task.
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    """Compare the two equal-sized panels separated by a uniform divider."""
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0])
    divider = next(c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid))
    left = [row[:divider] for row in grid]
    right = [row[divider + 1:] for row in grid]
    common = set(sum(left, [])) & set(sum(right, []))
    background = next(iter(common))
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] else background
             for c in range(len(left[0]))] for r in range(h)]
'''
p.write_text(source)
print(p.read_text())

def transform(grid):
    """Compare the two equal-sized panels separated by a uniform divider."""

    w = len(grid[0])
    divider = next(c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid))
    left = [row[:divider] for row in grid]
    right = [row[divider + 1:] for row in grid]
    common = set(sum(left, [])) & set(sum(right, []))
    background = next(iter(common))
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] else background
             for c in range(len(left[0]))] for r in range(h)]
